amaysim questions

What is the cheapest amaysim NBN plan?

NBN 25 NBN 25/10 at $30/mo for 6 months, then $70/mo. That is $600 over the first year (checked 8 October 2026).

Which mobile network does amaysim use?

amaysim runs on the Optus Network, which covers about 98.5% of Australians.

Has amaysim raised its prices recently?

Yes. The most recent ongoing price rise we recorded was 10GB 10GB on 2 October 2026, from $10 to $14.
